text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0832 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne down on lower CBOT soyoil calls with crushers expected to continue being absent despite profitable crush margins. July WCE futures crush margin fell to +3.39 Tuesday from +6.57 Monday. Local selling later in the session may test July's technical support at C$402. Canada's dollar was flat at C$1.3760 to the U.S. dollar, and rose to 84.53 yen and 1.2552 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.30 to C$0.90 a tonne down on allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on lower CBOT corn calls despite a C$2 to C$3 bounce expected in the near term.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 lower on U.S. corn and wheat calls with technical gaps seen above the market.
FEED PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 down on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
